course.title: Optics and Waves
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Two aeroplanes A and B are approaching each other and their velocities are 650km/hr and 850km/hr respectively. The frequency of the note emitted by A as heard by the passengers in B in 1100Hz. Calculate the frequency of the note as heard by the passengers in A. Velocity of sound in air is 332m/s.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
